rationale: The plan matches the reference: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts for an unpaired 3v3 single-batch design, blind VST PCA and distance heatmap with library-size checks, a minimal >=10-in->=3 filter tied to the smallest group, median-of-ratios inside the model, an explicit ~condition formula with control releveled and the contrast named, BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage, and the n=3 power caveat stated. Enrichment correctly acknowledges no zebrafish curated collection and takes the one-to-one human-ortholog fgsea path on the Wald statistic with a 15-500 size window and the mapped share reported. Deductions: the outlier handling is only a flag without a stated drop/keep policy, the babelgene ortholog-table version and the Ensembl release are deferred to the report rather than named in the plan, and the collection versions are not stated up front.
